description: Convert all five Top Floor (T.*) HVAC systems in the 4StoreyBuilding model from Packaged Single Zone (PSZ) to Packaged Variable Air Volume (PVAVS). For each of these systems, you must also implement Variable Speed Drive fan control (FAN-CONTROL = SPEED), set the cooling control strategy to supply air temperature reset (COOL-CONTROL = WARMEST), and set the maximum supply temperature to 65°F. Finally, run the full annual simulation and save the project. No UI navigation instructions are provided; you must locate the systems in the Air-Side HVAC module.
